derek_sales: Handoff - MonetaPay closed $250k ARR (regional payments). 12mo term, 8-week pilot. Top asks: Okta SSO, EU data residency, audit log exports to their S3, latency SLO <200ms for median inference. Pilot success: 3k MAU, <1% regression on key billing prompts. Pilot target kickoff: 2025-04-15.

keisha_csm: I'll own CSM. Need: signed scope (legal), SE perf plan, onboarding dates, and nominated Nimbus PM who'll be our SPOC.

derek_sales: Nimbus PM = cassie@monetapay.com, infra = infra@monetapay.com. Signed scope attached in Salesforce (deal 99823).

pablo_se: SE notes: mix of short transactions and some 2k-token receipts. Recommend rdx-13b-q4 for reranker; will run sandbox perf + quality tests. Need sample prompts and QPS histogram.

lina_onboard: I'll schedule two sessions: (1) Dev sandbox + SDKs, (2) Security & SSO with their secops. Plan to publish a "MonetaPay onboarding" runbook and invite both teams by 2025-03-28.

owen_support: Support lead here. Added PagerDuty escalation and will draft incident runbook for PCI-adjacent flows. Please grant support access to audit log bucket when ready.

sara_legal: Reviewing residency clause, will aim to counter-sign by 2025-03-22. Need confirmation of retention window for logs (they requested 24 months).

ci-bot: Sandbox environment monetapay-sbx created. CI build #119 queued; will update results here.

keisha_csm: Consolidated next steps: 1) Sales to confirm S3 + SAML metadata by 2025-03-20. 2) Pablo to post perf/quality results in thread by 2025-03-26. 3) Lina to publish runbook + calendar invites by 2025-03-28. 4) Sara to finish legal countersign by 2025-03-22. 5) Owen to attach support runbook by 2025-04-10. Low renewal risk at close; operational risk if SSO/residency blocks. I'll create the onboarding ticket and assign owners. Update this thread as items complete. Thanks!
